messages:
deploy-bot: deployed v2026.04.07 to prod; kickoff postdeploy checks: prefill-warmup, kv-health, embed-smoke. starting synthetic ramp across zones :rocket:
maya: apac1 prefill-warmup p95 jumped from 110ms -> 650ms around 2955555710, small increase in OOM alerts for one node pool
rick: grabbing node events now — saw a couple of OOMKilled entries and pod restarts, not across the whole pool
ops-bot: k8s events apac1:
```
Warning OOMKilled pod/prefill-b-13ab 2m kubelet
Normal  Pulled    pod/prefill-b-13ab 2m
Warning OOMKilled pod/prefill-c-77de 1m kubelet
```
qa-lead: the synth job ramped to full concurrency simultaneously in all zones (my bad, runbook used same start time)
maya: that explains thundering-warmup effect. can we throttle apac synths while we triage?
release-manager: i'd prefer soft mitigation first (stagger/slew), avoid rolling back unless impact grows
rick: i can patch the synth controller to add jitter and a 90s ramp for apac targets; applying now
ops-bot: synth controller patch applied to apac job: jitter=30-120s, ramp=90s, target-concurrency=60% for initial run
maya: prefill p95 fell back to ~150ms within 70s, no new OOMs in apac1 logs :white_check_mark:
qa-lead: running an extended warmup night-run with jitter enabled to validate memory behavior overnight
release-manager: filing ticket REL-2026-214 to add "stagger synth start times" to the release checklist and runbook
rick: follow-ups: 1) mem-profile prefills during warmup (assign to runtime) 2) add canary-level warmup phases (releases + runtime) 3) add alert if warmup p95 exceeds 300ms and OOMs spike (sre)
maya: recommendation: continue rollout but pin apac1 nodepool to v2026.04.07 with warmup override (batch_size=8) for 8 hours while we validate
release-manager: approve pin for 8h, add note to release notes: "APAC warmup jitter added; temporary batch_size override in apac1 after transient warmup pressure. No customer-visible errors."
ops-bot: postdeploy summary: apac1 prefill warmup transiently high -> mitigated by synth jitter + batch_size override. no rollback performed. ticket REL-2026-214 created
qa-lead: adding a new nightly smoke case: "prefill warmup stress with jitter off/on" to catch regressions
release-manager: will include short blurb in release changelog and schedule follow-up triage in AM sync
